notes.title: New Patch - Bug Fixes and Weapon Balance
notes.notes:
Following changes happen in this patch:

- Top 10 Bat collider now is turned off at start

- Bull Ramming now Ignores rolling immunity

- All melee weapons now deal 10 point of damage

- All melee weapons' knock-back power increase 10%

notes.title: Full Release in November, New Weapons
notes.notes:
Great News! We are transitioning from Early Access to Full Release in late November! The exact date has not been set yet, but it will be announced later! 

We are also working on some new weapons to add to the gameplay. There will be more wild ways to push your enemy off the platform. Your play style in Don't Fall will become more diverse than ever before.  If you want to know the details of the new weapons, please join our Discord at https://discord.gg/ueSxuGs  . This weapon update will release before Don't Fall become fully released. 

We are fully aware the problem of insufficient player count. This is why we want to exit the phase of early access. By releasing the game and setting a price, we can participate in discount events so that Don't Fall can get more traffic on Steam. 

Thank you for participating the Early Access of Don't Fall!

notes.title: New Patch Fixes Animation Issue
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the problem that may occur during the match. Enemy players may stuck in the damaged state and not return to normal which makes this player immune to additional damage. This patch makes sure enemy players always return to normal after damages. 

If you are not running the latest version, it will be difficult to find a match.
Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: New Patch Fixes Sprint Mask Issue
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the problem that may occur after using the sprint mask. Players who has used the mask may be unable to use the mask again. This patch makes sure players will return to the normal state after using sprint mask. 

If you are not running the latest version, it will be difficult to find a match.
Please update to the latest version.
